front_door.description: Recessed single-leaf door beneath an ornate stucco arch/porch; light-colored; short step up from small front garden.

access_notes: Small, narrow front garden with low brick wall and gate opening.
Short path from pavement; 1–2 steps to threshold.
Cars parked on both sides of Kellett Road reduce carriageway width.
No hydrant marker or standpipe visible in the street-view images.
obstacles: Wheelie bins in the small front garden
Occasional bicycles locked to front boundary/railings nearby
rear_access_note: Mid-terrace property with enclosed rear garden backing onto other gardens; no alley or side passage visible in satellite view.
parking: On-street kerbside parking on Kellett Road; appliance could park at the kerb outside or opposite the property if space is available.
